EN:
{{TAG:0003:000F:}}You changed your mind? That's
not very nice when I'm feeling
so awful, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

{{TAG:0003:000F:}}¿No sabes que no hay que alterar

{{TAG:0003:000F:}}Hai cambiato idea? Ma non hai

 bu kadar kötü hissederken hiç

{{TAG:0005:0008:}}. I'm sick!
